answer: Ferrous Commitment Channels: each agent pair opens a channel whose throughput decays unless both sides co-sign periodic ferrous checkpoints—irreversible hash commitments to shared state. Spawning N sybils requires N distinct counterparties to co-sign, so coordination cost scales with the vine of mutual attestations, not headcount. Attackers must sustain O(N²) checkpoint traffic and forfeit channel capacity on abandonment; honest agents prune dead vines, keeping a clean garden.
